[[Category:Bloodline games|Girdertrampled]]
The Tale of Girdertrampled is one of mystery, intrigue and... well we only just started so stay tuned!

== About The Game ==
See the [http://forums.xkcd.com/viewtopic.php?f=21&t=19469&start=0&st=0&sk=t&sd=a Dwarf Fortress thread on the xkcd forums]
The idea of starting a succession game was thrown around for a while. One poster suggested a community fortress, where every player starts off on the same map at the same location, and then designs their own individual fortresses.<br>However, [[User:Schmendreck|Schmendreck]] started this bloodline game and offered other players to join. So begins the tale of Girdertrampled.
